problem_choice.rationale: Frozen candidate-pack E1: label-budgeted active learning on public ADME screens. Prior sweep (sweep_al_v2) was NO-GO on built-in uncertainty/greedy; phase7_lipo showed margin/diversity candidates do not beat random EF1% under the frozen al_screen gate — next run must close build on any verifier-owned results.json and package an honest positive OR negative without thrashing for success=true.

hypotheses.statement: An ε-greedy mix of uncertainty exploration and greedy enrichment raises EF1% over random acquisition under a fixed 10% label budget.
hypotheses.falsification: After ≥5 seeds on Lipophilicity_AstraZeneca, candidate mean EF1 does not beat random with Holm-adjusted p<0.05 and Cohen's d≥0.5.

mission.goal: Register protocol hashes for the campaign.
Enact campaign_rules under GRUNDNORM G3: allowed/forbidden, audit_matrix (every promotable output audited), scoring mode. Bootstrap may mirror GRUNDNORM; council may revise later via ledger.
Map literature for label-budgeted AL in virtual screening; confirm E1 remains the working problem; record resolvable citations. Do NOT transfer EF multipliers from other datasets as promises.
Propose falsifiable acquisition-function hypotheses grounded in lit_map. Calibrate effect sizes to THIS dataset/eval; cross-domain 2× claims are disallowed without local evidence.

Implement one acquisition module (acquire + NAME) and score it via run_eval problem_id=al_screen. Artifact is verifier-owned. Mission COMPLETE when a valid frozen results.json exists — whether success is true OR false. Do not thrash to force a win; an honest negative eval is a successful build deliverable.
Attack the current claim. If frozen success=false, verdict must be falsified or revise — never hunt promote on a negative result.
Write an honest manuscript draft grounded only in frozen numbers. Negative results are first-class deliverables.

risks: Small ADME sets underpower EF1@1%; honest NO-GO must be acceptable.
LLM may invent results — blocked by artifact_source=verifier.
Conflating success=true with mission-complete causes build thrashing (phase7_lipo).
Narrative/ledger drift — mitigated by mandatory post-mission audits + scorecard.
fallback: If build yields success=false, still package an honest-negative ARM.
